Container.Name: Chaptarr

Branch.TagDescription: Stable releases, promoted after they have run on develop

Container.Overview: Chaptarr is a Readarr fork built to accommodate audiobook and eBook libraries in one instance. It helps you organize and maintain a collection of books with rich metadata, including narrator and edition information that many general-purpose media managers struggle to track. Chaptarr is an independent project and is not affiliated with the Servarr team or the Readarr, Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, or Prowlarr projects.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface. Change this if another container uses it; keep the container port at 8789.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent settings, database, and cached artwork. Unraid uses your configured appdata location by default.

Config.Name: Media and downloads
Config.Description: Choose your media and downloads share, for example /mnt/user/data. Download paths must match those reported by your download client. Chaptarr can modify or delete mapped contents where filesystem permissions allow.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that can read and write your media, downloads, and appdata. Unraid's nobody user is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that can read and write your media, downloads, and appdata. Unraid's users group is 100.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions mask for newly created files and folders. 002 allows the shared group to write; it does not change existing file permissions.
